usedFor: TallyPrime holds vouchers and orders, and viaSocket utilities adds a wait through “Pause Workflow” before the next step.

bestTemplate.name: “New Purchase Order event occurs” in TallyPrime, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: Pausing after a purchase order spaces out whatever step comes next.

watchOut: “Pause Workflow” waits for a set time, so a step after it must do the real work.
